user_machine_keyword_test._comment: null (use machine.json default), str (shortcut used in machine.json (ex: v100), list of str (project,allocation,arch, ex [myproject,myalloc,v100])

is_compressed._comment: bool. This placeholder is only used if you create an input.json; with no input.json at all, ArcaNN instead copies the value from that iteration's control/training_XXX.json

deepmd_model_version._comment: str, values: 2.0, 2.1, 2.2 or 3.0. Same caveat as is_compressed: only used if you create an input.json, otherwise copied from control/training_XXX.json
